rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Delimit provides a shared workspace for AI coding assistants including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It offers API governance tools for OpenAPI spec linting, breaking change detection with semver classification, security auditing, test verification, and a persistent task ledger that carries context across sessions. Includes a GitHub Action for automated PR-level API contract checking and a CLI for local development workflows.
